measurementMode: One current table baseline receipt, prior PDF repair receipt as historical reference, and one new combined prior-overlay-plus-economy candidate run. The new candidate is not an economy-only causal arm.

metricDefinitions.rowHit: The existing frozen scorer predicate: a returned chunk has the gold row label and exact complete gold numeric sequence on one line; this remains the primary legacy serialization-sensitive metric.
metricDefinitions.rowAndHeader: The row-hit predicate succeeds and required header tokens appear somewhere in the same returned text; this does not prove same-cell/header binding.
metricDefinitions.pdfDerivedCompleteCorrectRow: A unique same-document PDF-native row label maps to the gold row, all seven source-derived values exactly match the frozen gold values, and that exact complete row body appears in a returned chunk. This is a post-freeze retrieval diagnostic, not semantic acceptance.
metricDefinitions.pdfEconomyCompleteCorrectRow: The same rule restricted to newly appended PDF-native economy row records.
metricDefinitions.anyPdfOverlayRangeOverlap: A cited same-document verified range overlaps any PDF-derived source range; overlap alone does not establish a complete or correct row.
metricDefinitions.historicalPriorOverlay: A separate earlier run on the prior 59-row PDF repair overlay; descriptive reference only, not a contemporaneous arm.
